items.q: Who is A Better Tomorrow Social for?
items.a: Women in Houston who want more from a night out — friendship, networking and a reason to give back. If you love a good dress code and a good cause, you’re one of us.

items.q: How do I get tickets to a social?
items.a: RSVP through the link in our Instagram bio. Tickets are sold through Eventbrite and availability is limited, so grab yours early.
Every experience raises money for a Houston organization supporting women and children. So far that has included Daya Houston, the Houston Food Bank and The Avondale House.

items.q: How do I become a member?
items.a: DM us on Instagram for club membership inquiries, or fill out the quick form below and we’ll get back to you.

items.q: Can my business sponsor or partner with ABT?
items.a: Yes! Our socials are made possible by local sponsors, florists and venues. Tell us about your business in the form below.

items.q: Do I need to bring anything?
items.a: Sometimes! Some socials include a donation drive (like hygiene products for Galentine’s). Each event post shares the dress code and what to bring.

story.lead: A Better Tomorrow Social is a community rooted in connection, empowerment, and impact.
body: We curate intentional social gatherings and one-of-a-kind experiences where like-minded women come together to build genuine friendships, expand their networks, and create unforgettable memories. But what makes us different is the mission behind the moment.

Every experience we host is designed to pour into you and pour into others. With each gathering, we raise proceeds and give back to causes that support women and children — because we believe the best kind of luxury is creating change and leaving a legacy.
